description: This file contains API functions for fetching user analytics data, including active user trends and tenant user summaries, from a backend service. It uses axios for HTTP requests and exports functions for external use.

methods.name: getActiveUsersTrend
methods.description: Fetches the trend of active users over a specified period from the backend API.

methods.name: getTenantUsersSummary
methods.description: Fetches a summary of users grouped by tenant, with normalization of the response shape.
